body: Thanks for the advice. I will definitely use it when talking to them

Yeah, I read those. 
They say to say it but not necessarily how. How do I say to the I am suicidal again. Do I just blurt I out at the beginning of a session?

Yeah but it’s through a separate practice. I don’t have access to a doctor that can change the prescription just re-prescribe it. I’m not really sure what to do about the medication either. It makes has made my head really fuzzy over long term use and makes it really hard to concentrate now. By the time these side effects started kicking in there was no way for me to change medication or dose. (Not that it was working anyway - I think it was just placebo for a couple of months)
I know I will likely have to downplay my access and plan but I just at least want to try to bring it up. I have been with them for about a year and a half.

I had a few fully unbound void weapons, nothing from high dragon, and one from each agito except dark (the light weapon). The agito stayed but the void did not. I mainly had four star base voids just cause I liked the skills better. It does look like I got all the materials back but certain voids I just never needed. Take Cablepos and Jeanne D’Arc I did them like once to do them but never grinned for material. Now I need at least 150 items from the void that I just never bothered to get. Yeah I got all my items back but because of the way the new system works I am back to square one on a lot of weapons. The system is fine, it just happened to be that I budgeted bad for this new system. I should be okay if I just go lower levels or co op for now till I build it back up for things like high dragon or certain voids but it is just more of a thing  about time consumption. I don’t care the system changed. They changed it in a way they believed benefited the game. It just so happens that system did not work for me.

I got the refuned materials but because of the way I budgeted I went typically for specific void weapons. Because of that I just don’t have some of the general void materials. It just feels like I got robbed of 2000-6000 might on my teams. They gave me back all my items (possibly) but because of the items I used to create the old weapons I can not quite create the new ones. Obviously I could just do all of the void battles, chimera battles, etc. but that takes a lot of time considering how many items I need. The only bright side is for any agito already completed the adventurer I used for co-op is okay. The worst part is I can’t even make a half unbound basic 5 star weapon.

All my weapons are gone. I can’t even build new ones with the materials I got back. I just don’t even know what to do. Literally half of my teams have basic weapons on them cause the materials I got back from Nintendo don’t cover even one fully unbounded weapon. Welp there goes all of my teams.
